explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/375: Ramachandra–Shorey–Tijdeman proved the conjecture for k ≪ (log n/log log n)³. The statement gives ∃ c > 0 such that for all n, k with k < c(log n/log log n)³ the conclusion holds. As the docstring argues, quantifying over all n is harmless. For n ≤ 2 the bound is non-positive, and for the finitely many small n where the ratio is large, c can be taken small enough to force k = 0. Faithful.
